ayahs.tj: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا ١
ayahs.en: By those [angels] who extract with violence

ayahs.tj: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا ٢
ayahs.en: And [by] those who remove with ease

ayahs.tj: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا ٣
ayahs.en: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

ayahs.tj: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا ٤
ayahs.en: And those who race each other in a race

ayahs.tj: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٲتِ أَمْرًا ٥
ayahs.en: And those who arrange [each] matter,

ayahs.tj: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ ٦
ayahs.en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

ayahs.tj: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ ٧
ayahs.en: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

ayahs.tj: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ ٨
ayahs.en: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

ayahs.tj: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ ٩
ayahs.en: Their eyes humbled.

ayahs.tj: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ ١٠
ayahs.en: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

ayahs.tj: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً ١١
ayahs.en: Even if we should be decayed bones?

ayahs.tj: قَالُواْ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ ١٢
ayahs.en: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

ayahs.tj: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٲحِدَةٌ ١٣
ayahs.en: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

ayahs.tj: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ ١٤
ayahs.en: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

ayahs.tj: هَلْ أَتَـٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ١٥
ayahs.en: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

ayahs.ar: إِذ نادىٰهُ رَبُّهُ بِالوادِ المُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.tj: إِذْ نَادَٮٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى ١٦
ayahs.en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,

ayahs.tj: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ١٧
ayahs.en: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

ayahs.ar: فَقُل هَل لَكَ إِلىٰ أَن تَزَكّىٰ
ayahs.tj: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ ١٨
ayahs.en: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

ayahs.tj: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ ١٩
ayahs.en: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

ayahs.tj: فَأَرَٮٰهُ ٱلْأَيَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ٢٠
ayahs.en: And he showed him the greatest sign,

ayahs.tj: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ ٢١
ayahs.en: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.

ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ ٢٢
ayahs.en: Then he turned his back, striving.

ayahs.tj: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ ٢٣
ayahs.en: And he gathered [his people] and called out

ayahs.tj: فَقَالَ أَنَا۟ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ٢٤
ayahs.en: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

ayahs.tj: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْأَخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ ٢٥
ayahs.en: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَعِبرَةً لِمَن يَخشىٰ
ayahs.tj: إِنَّ فِى ذَٲلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ ٢٦
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].

ayahs.ar: ءَأَنتُم أَشَدُّ خَلقًا أَمِ السَّماءُ بَنىٰها
ayahs.tj: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ‌ۚ بَنَـٰهَا ٢٧
ayahs.en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.

ayahs.tj: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّٮٰهَا ٢٨
ayahs.en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

ayahs.tj: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَـٰهَا ٢٩
ayahs.en: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

ayahs.tj: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٲلِكَ دَحَـٰهَآ ٣٠
ayahs.en: And after that He spread the earth.

ayahs.tj: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَـٰهَا ٣١
ayahs.en: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

ayahs.tj: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَـٰهَا ٣٢
ayahs.en: And the mountains He set firmly

ayahs.tj: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ ٣٣
ayahs.en: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.

ayahs.tj: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ٣٤
ayahs.en: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

ayahs.tj: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ ٣٥
ayahs.en: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

ayahs.tj: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ ٣٦
ayahs.en: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

ayahs.tj: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ ٣٧
ayahs.en: So as for he who transgressed

ayahs.tj: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٲةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ٣٨
ayahs.en: And preferred the life of the world,

ayahs.tj: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ٣٩
ayahs.en: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

ayahs.ar: وَأَمّا مَن خافَ مَقامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفسَ عَنِ الهَوىٰ
ayahs.tj: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ ٤٠
ayahs.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

ayahs.tj: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ٤١
ayahs.en: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

ayahs.tj: يَسْــَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَـٰهَا ٤٢
ayahs.en: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

ayahs.tj: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَٮٰهَآ ٤٣
ayahs.en: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

ayahs.tj: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَـٰهَآ ٤٤
ayahs.en: To your Lord is its finality.

ayahs.tj: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَـٰهَا ٤٥
ayahs.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

ayahs.ar: كَأَنَّهُم يَومَ يَرَونَها لَم يَلبَثوا إِلّا عَشِيَّةً أَو ضُحىٰها
ayahs.tj: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَـٰهَا ٤٦
ayahs.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
